# Generated evidence: eth/transfer

Written by `pnpm report eth/transfer --record` from `templates/eth/transfer/template.json`, `templates/eth/transfer/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `testdata/report/eth-transfer.json`, `testdata/abi`, `testdata/research/eth-transfer.json`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-26. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm instance-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer, and no program reads their answers live again. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Etherscan gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.

## Findings

0 key and 0 reference findings.

Key: it bears on whether an address or its code is the protocol's real one and does what the template assumes. Reference: context to weigh that undermines neither. A place with nothing to compare, such as one that does not list the address, prints as NOT LISTED or n/a in its table and is no finding.
